_comment: Veins are a skin rather than a block, so powder spreads twice as far: 1 powder to 2 veins.
TWO powder rather than one, and that is not a price - it is what keeps the recipe reachable.
sculk_from_powder is shapeless and takes ONE powder, so a one-powder vein recipe accepts exactly
the same grid, and a grid resolves to a single result: whichever recipe the map yielded first won
and the other could never be crafted at all. Caught in review on #267 by
every_crafting_recipe_is_reachable_at_a_bench, which is also what found the trommel/pulverizer
pair that had shipped that way since #197. The ratio is untouched - 2 powder, 4 veins.
